scheme_name: Financial Assistance for the Treatment of Blind, Disabled, Deaf, Dumb, or Mentally Challenged Ex-Servicemen and their Dependents (Wife and Children)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Rajasthan.
Applicant must be either an ex‑serviceman of rank Havildar or below, or a dependent (wife, widow, son, or daughter) of such ex‑serviceman.
The ex‑serviceman or dependent must have a disability of 40% or more.
Parents are not eligible as dependents.
Both pensioners and non‑pensioners are eligible, but an ex‑serviceman receiving a disability pension cannot apply for himself and may only apply on behalf of a disabled family member.
A valid recommendation from the District Sainik Welfare Officer (DSWO) is mandatory.
Assistance can be availed by a maximum of two eligible family members per ex‑serviceman.
Application must be submitted through the District Sainik Welfare Office that issued the identity card.
Renewals are required every three years.
benefits_summary: Monthly financial assistance of ₹3,000, ₹2,000 or ₹1,000 for three years, based on disability percentage (≥80%, 60‑79%, 40‑59% respectively).
documents_required: Copies of mandatory documents as required by the application form
Recommendation letter from the District Sainik Welfare Officer (DSWO)
Discharge book or Part II Order showing the name of the disabled family member
